text.p: Alusuisse Lonza Group chief executive Sergio Marchionne said group business volumes in most of the company's businesses have been relatively good so far this year and group profits in 1997 are expected to exceed those of 1996.
Marchionne said in a statement issued at a news conference that he was extremely pleased with the performance of the aluminium business, "which will substantially out-distance the 1996 mark".
Packaging activities also performed well and in line with expectations.
However, this performance was offset by poor results at the chemical sectors in the first five months of 1997, he added.
"Overall, Lonza will achieve lower results for the first half of the year than in 1996," Marchionne said.
He noted sales volume in the Lonza chemical division was higher, but "technical difficulties" in the Swiss and American fine chemical operations put a dent in the division's results so far this year.
"We confirm, however, that group results for 1997 will exceed those of the prior year," Marchionne said.
In April Alusuisse said its 1997 profit was expected to exceed 1996's 417 million Swiss francs.
